service_constraint_definition: Each unit-resultant load compliance must be no greater than the uniform plate. These are illustrative rigidity constraints, not real product function/stress/buckling requirements.
selection: Enumerate the same mass-constrained grid; retain feasible static minimax normalized service compliance, first-frequency maximum, worst sampled averaged boundary maximum, and mean boundary maximum; all share identical service constraints.
falsification: No benefit over both static and frequency baselines, disappearance under Ritz/periodic checks, constraint violations on refined model, or absence of distinct literature contribution prevents a method claim.
budget: 85 small deterministic designs, no training; at most 240 seconds initial screening; bounded selected-profile checks. No independent-sample significance test.
limitations: Illustrative material/cutting/damping. Kirchhoff-Love Ritz plate not full shell/solid FE. Four piecewise thickness patches centered on common midsurface; no eccentricity, stress, ribs, material-removal stages, real toolpath or measured plate validation. Point cutting contacts and scalar transverse loop remain approximations.
